prerequisites: Accepted/integrated C02, C04 and I00; announce actual resulting integration SHA. Do not implement or dispatch I01 before C04 acceptance.
Transfer queue/worker ownership from C04 and ports/contracts/sqlite ownership from C02 to I01; retain accepted lifecycle and approval semantics.
Integrator approve proposed transaction interface and DTO/port signatures before implementation.

Obtain verified SDK/account/quote/billing evidence producer design: configured key or model catalog availability is insufficient. Missing production evidence means blocked paid pipeline, even if fake fixtures pass.
Provider factory, HTTP quote handler and worker CLI composition are outside I01 owned files: integrator must assign narrow amendments or expose injected producers without silently widening ownership.

existing_boundaries.store: ProductionStore.transaction is synchronous and uses SQLite immediate transaction. Reuse same configured production.sqlite; no parallel ledger DB. Existing ProductionWritePort extends read port and exposes updateLeasedJob/appendJobEvent.
existing_boundaries.runtime: withProductionStore lazily opens/closes configured PERABYTE_STUDIO_DATA_DIR or cwd/.studio. Keep injected services; no global setter.
existing_boundaries.queue: beginSubmission currently delegates separate update transaction. Eligibility helper can consume transaction read port.
existing_boundaries.worker: authorizeSubmission async boolean at worker.ts:61 followed by beginSubmission at :68 cannot atomically reserve and enter submitting. Capability/account discovery stays outside transactions.
existing_boundaries.quote: Existing Quote has inputHash, entitlement, minor estimates, currency, expiry but no evidenced account/credential/unit binding. Preserve v1 Quote with typed companion binding where sufficient.

proposed_interface_amendment.queue_command: beginAuthorizedSubmission(jobId, lease, expectedEligibility, capability, reserveInTransaction, now): ProductionJob|null
proposed_interface_amendment.reserve_callback: reserveInTransaction(tx: ProductionWritePort, current: ProductionJob, quote: ProductionQuote, capability: CapabilityReceipt, now: number): BudgetReservation; synchronous trusted server service callback, no network/filesystem.
proposed_interface_amendment.worker_option: Replace authorizeSubmission?: async boolean with injected synchronous reserveInTransaction callback. Missing callback stays BUDGET_BLOCKED. Worker invokes queue.beginAuthorizedSubmission once after asynchronous evidence discovery; no standalone reserve transaction.
transaction_algorithm: Read current job by ID; require expected pre-submit status, current live leaseToken/deadline and unchanged requestHash/snapshot. Validate quote project/provider/model/operation/exact server quote-input binding, fresh expiry and capability at current clock.

Recompute productionSubmissionEligibilityFingerprint(tx,current,quote,snapshot) and compare expectedEligibility inside transaction, preserving current latest story/animatic/anchor decisions, plan membership and selected canon.

Synchronous budget service rechecks latest account policy/project authorization CAS versions, expiry/revocation, operation/model/entitlement scope, fresh evidence and credential/connection binding; sums project known actual plus all unresolved reservations and original-day account liability with safe integer arithmetic.

Insert unique reservation pinned to execution ID/project/idempotency/request hash/authorization/quote/evidence/account/unit/currency/original UTC bucket; exact replay is no-op, conflicting replay rejects.

Update leased job to submitting and append event through same tx. Any failed lease/status/CAS/event/ledger write throws and rolls back entire reserve+transition. Return current refreshed submitting job, not stale caller lease fields.
proposed_interface_amendment.after_commit: Provider I/O follows committed boundary. Recheck ownership/cancellation and preserved eligibility immediately before submit without new awaits. If affirmative server evidence proves call was never started, record idempotent nonacceptance release; otherwise any timeout/crash/cancellation/unknown keeps reservation. Revocation after atomic submission boundary does not retroactively erase liability.
proposed_interface_amendment.recovery: Expired submitting jobs enter submission_unknown, never call reserve-and-submit again. Recovered reference/receipt resumes same request. Existing reservation replay never grants permission to resubmit an uncertain acceptance.

dto_and_port_proposals: Strict AccountBudgetPolicy (provider/account/currency/unit, version, daily cap, expiry nullable, revoked, actor/time) and immutable BudgetAuthorization (project + policy ref/version, project cap, bounded model/operation/mode scopes, expiry, actor/time). Separate latest-pointer CAS from append-only versions.
AccountEvidence (stable provider account ID, source/reference, observedAt/expiresAt, nonsecret credential/connection binding). Trusted producer verifies; browser cannot insert evidence.

QuoteAccountBinding (quoteId, exact quoted input snapshot/hash, execution semantic binding, evidenceId/account/binding/currency/unit); reserve rejects credential/account drift. Do not hash ProviderRequestSnapshot directly against Quote.inputHash because existing quote shape differs.

BudgetReservation + append-only ReconciliationEvidence/BillingEvent; states distinguish reserved, known actual, confirmed release, unresolved. Provider facts and explicit human manual facts have distinct provenance; duplicate identical event no-op, conflicting event-key atomically rejects.

Read ports get latest account policy/project authorization/evidence/quote binding, lookup execution reservation, query project and UTC account totals. Write ports append version with CAS, insert evidence/binding/reservation, append unique reconciliation event; persistence enforces natural uniqueness/FKs.

Text operation is absent from media-only Quote operation enum. Require explicit I01 DTO/ledger amendment supporting text proposal server execution IDs before I02 charged calls; no fake media job/approval.

tasks.work: Freeze strict DTOs, arithmetic and totals semantics; test null standing expiry vs null unauthorized caps, min>max, mixed unit/currency, overflow, bounded model/operation scope, browser billing-forgery rejection.

Add ordered version-2 migration without changing 001.sql; immutable policy/auth/evidence/event tables and unique reservation/event keys. Preserve existing records and known-version rejection. Reopen old/fresh DB and verify migration once, FK integrity, atomic rollback, CAS and replay.

Inject store and trusted evidence producers. Authorize/revoke policies via same-origin bounded strict commands and server account binding; GET returns liability/unknown/overrun safely. Never accept browser actual/refund facts.

Implement approved synchronous atomic boundary. Real two-store SQLite concurrent jobs/projects: only one fits jointly; exactly one reserve/submit. Cover lease/approval/policy revoke races, stale quote/account binding, rollback and uncertain acceptance recovery.

Reconcile trusted events independently of media completion. Verify affirmative nonbilling release once; generic failure/cancel/unknown retains; duplicate/conflicting settlement and partial refund; actual overrun; lowered caps and renewals preserve totals; project outstanding liability survives midnight while original daily bucket remains pinned.

verification_policy: Future implementer saves behavioral RED then GREEN and real SQLite reopen/race outputs with hashes, no real credentials/network/billing. Integrator runs broader tests/build at integration milestone. This planning turn ran no tests.
